# LatamJobs API

> Una API REST que une Computrabajo, Bumeran, OCC, ZonaJobs y Laborum en una sola llamada. Salario parseado a número y moneda. Ofertas deduplicadas. Hecho para recruiters y HR-tech builders en LATAM.

## What this is

LatamJobs API is a unified job board API for Latin America. Instead of opening 5 browser tabs and copy-pasting into Excel, you call one endpoint and get back structured JSON with normalized salaries and deduplicated postings.

## Status

**Validating demand.** Si llegamos a 30 recruiters o HR-tech builders en LATAM, abrimos el acceso. Precio founding: $49/mes de por vida.

- Pricing: https://latam-jobs-api.vercel.app/#pricing
- Demo: https://latam-jobs-api.vercel.app/#demo
- Signup: https://latam-jobs-api.vercel.app/#signup

## Endpoints

### GET /v1/search
Search jobs across all portals (Computrabajo, Bumeran, OCC, ZonaJobs, Laborum).

Parameters:
- `q` (string, required): keyword — job title, skill, company
- `country` (string): comma-separated ISO codes (mx, co, ar, cl, pe, uy)
- `salary_min` (number): minimum salary in USD
- `limit` (number): 1-100, default 20

Returns:
```json
{
  "results": [
    {
      "id": "abc123",
      "title": "Backend Developer Python",
      "company": "Mercado Libre",
      "location": "Ciudad de México, MX",
      "salary": {
        "min": 45000,
        "max": 70000,
        "currency": "MXN",
        "period": "monthly"
      },
      "posted_at": "2026-09-19T14:22:00Z",
      "sources": ["computrabajo", "bumeran"],
      "url": "https://..."
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "total": 1247,
    "fetched_ms": 3120
  }
}
```

### POST /v1/webhooks
Subscribe to job notifications for keywords.

### GET /v1/jobs/:id
Fetch a single job detail by ID.

## Authentication

`Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY` header. Keys are issued after early access.

## Rate limits

- Free: 500 calls/mes
- Indie: 10,000 calls/mes
- Scale: 100,000 calls/mes

## Sources scraped

- Computrabajo (19 countries)
- Bumeran (AR, MX, CL)
- OCC Mundial (MX)
- ZonaJobs (AR)
- Laborum (CL)
- El Empleo (CO)

## Use cases

- ATS that needs LATAM coverage
- HR-tech SaaS building for recruiters
- AI agents doing job research
- Market research on LATAM hiring trends
- Salary benchmarking across countries
